course_review/1.card_source: golfify (https://www.golfify.io/courses/painted-hills-golf-course), re-fetched 2026-10-30 (course_data/research/web/rv08_shawnee_painted/01.txt); OpenGolfAPI has only White and disagrees on 2/6/11 with an internally inconsistent total (5352 vs stated 5440)

holes.notes: Tee by the clubhouse, routing matches OSM hole way. Blue lidar pad 376 vs card 381, White 357 vs 362. Landing on fairway near a cart-path crossing. Tee CHECK is only because OSM maps no tee boxes here.
Routing OK. Blue 427/430, White 404/405 (golfify; OpenGolfAPI's White 380 is an outlier, its own total does not add up). Landing pattern edges into trees right; pick Driver plausible.
Par 3, 157/158; target box on the OSM green. OK.
Par 5, 477/478, White 436/437. Landing near a fairway bunker; pick plausible.
Par 3, Blue walkback 179 (= card by construction), White lidar pad 160/162. Box on green. OK.

Par 4 dogleg left. Blue lidar pad measures 316 vs card 327 (-11); a tee pad is visible at the marker and no clearer pad ~11 yds behind on 2021 NAIP 0.6 m, so likely a measuring difference. White 303/303. Calm pick aims 40 yds left (cutting the dogleg; tie at Blue) - plausible but the least certain pick on the course.
Par 3, 194/194; White pad 176 vs card 166 (+10). Box on green. OK.
Par 4, 307/307, finishing by the clubhouse. Driver toward the green-side bunkers is plausible on a 307-yd hole.
Par 5, 521/522 (Blue on a texture pad), White 495/496. Landing ellipse over a brownish strip (long grass?) right of centre; pick plausible.
Par 3, 196/196 (OpenGolfAPI White 159 is an outlier; golfify 177 matches the 176 pad). Box on green. OK.
Par 5 dogleg, 483 vs 492 (-9), White 458/465. Aims 28-40 yds left with the dogleg. OK.
Par 4, 290/290, short hole by the pond. OK.
Par 4, Blue walkback 390/391 sits ~8 yds behind the visible pad; within tolerance. Landing area has a tree clump and cart path - pick 4-wood plausible.

OSM has no golf=hole way for 17 (17 of 18), so the geometry fallback built it with par '17', hcp 3 and no card yards; the page treats it as a tee-shot hole (Mid iron landing 192 yds out on a 139-yd hole). Card: par 3, hcp 18, Blue 144, White 142. The green and the back tee pad (hole-line start, 139 yds) look right on the picture; forward pads ~23/45 yds ahead match Gold 121 / Red 101.
Par 4, 295/297, finishing at the clubhouse; driveable, aim near the green. OK.

course_notes: 17 of 18 holes OK (all tee CHECKs are because OSM maps no tee boxes; measured lengths are within 11 yds of the card).
Hole 17 must be fixed before publishing: par 17 / tee-shot play on a 144-yd par 3; course par sums to 84 instead of 70.
